_note: Draft for the maintainer, in the shape of the Space's data/methodology.json entrants.entrants records (the lab's entrant_metadata.py is not public). Values are what this run loaded; the maintainer's own run on the RTX PRO 6000 is authoritative.
name: Jebadiah 9B v1
served_params_detail: 8,953,803,264 base text parameters (Qwen3_5ForCausalLM, the text-only class the published loader uses; no vision tower is loaded) plus 43,278,336 LoRA parameters
readout: One forward pass per question over AINode's decide prompt (Qwen chat template, thinking off); the answer is the softmax over the option-label token logits at the answer position, read in fp32 from the last hidden state, divided by the adapter's per-type temperature (choice 1.1301, noul 1.2641; temperatures.json, the 'train' fit). No generation, no abstention outcome.

declared_capacity.max_options_detail: the single-token label alphabet at the answer boundary of the Qwen3.5 tokenizer: A..Z, then the 562 two-letter uppercase strings that are one token there (AINode's own alphabet is 68 labels; wider questions use the published extended alphabet). The suite's widest question has 255 options, so no request is refused for width.

engine_adapter: adapter/jebadiah_engine.py:JebadiahEngine (with adapter/mps_delta.py, used on Apple MPS only)
